exact_differences.target: Validate any project artifact (spec.md, ADR, roadmap, plan, or custom document) against CONSTITUTION.md principles, constraints, and quality standards. OUTPUTS: Detailed validation report with compliance score, principle violations, constraint breaches, and remediation recommendations.
